phases.label: first-half
phases.prompt:
We are triaging the customer messages in inbox/ (msg-01.txt to msg-10.txt). For each message, write a file triage/<same file name> containing exactly one line: <label> <priority>.

The rules for this job:
- Label FIN for messages about billing, invoices or payments. Label ACC for messages about logging in or account access. Label GEN for everything else.
- Exception: any message that mentions the Lisbon office gets label LIS, whatever its topic.
- Priority P1 when the message mentions a deadline or a date by which something is needed, otherwise P3.

Do only msg-01.txt to msg-05.txt now, then stop and tell me you are done with the first half. I will ask you to carry on later. Do not write these rules into any file.
